message.title: A message from the couple
message.body: We are both so delighted that you are able to join us in celebrating what we hope will be one of the happiest days of our lives. The affection shown to us by so many people since our roka has been incredibly moving, and has touched us both deeply. We would like to take this opportunity to thank everyone most sincerely for their kindness.We are looking forward to see you at the wedding.

rsvp.title: Looking forward to see you
rsvp.dialogTitle: We look forward to seeing you
rsvp.dialogBody: Please let the couple know you are coming — they would love to hear from you.

guide.title: Things to know
guide.subtitle: To help you feel at ease and enjoy every moment of the celebrations, we’ve gathered a few thoughtful details we’d love for you to know before the big day.
guide.hashtagBody: While posting photos on social media please use the hashtag - #abkan
guide.weatherBody: It will be mostly sunny with temperature reaching up to 28 degrees at the venue
guide.stayBody: We recommend the nearby hotel called Bhola Bhawan near the venue for the staff members
guide.parkingBody: Valet parking for all our guests will be available at the venue
